description: Use this when the user wants a printable lined paper, Cornell notes template, music staff paper, guitar tab paper or calligraphy guide sheet as a PDF. Lined paper is wide, college or narrow ruled or any spacing; Cornell notes have a cue column, notes area, summary box and name/date/topic header; music staff paper sets staves per page; calligraphy guides set x-height, ascender:x-height:descender ratio and slant angle. Does not make letter tracing or handwriting practice worksheets.

calibration_ruler.description: Print the 5 cm or 2 in check ruler in the bottom margin, e.g. true. Default true.

line_color.description: Line colour as a name or hex, e.g. "light blue", "gray", "green", "black" or "#4A7FC1". Default depends on the type.

line_weight.description: Line thickness in points or a word, e.g. 0.4, "0.25 pt", "thin" or "bold". Default 0.4 pt (dots 1.4 pt).

major_every.description: Draw a heavier line every N squares, e.g. 5 or 10. Default none (engineering: 5 per inch; 1 mm paper: 10).

margin.description: Page margin, e.g. "10 mm" or "0.5 in". Default 1/2 in on US pages, 10 mm on A pages; at least 0.2 in.

name_date.description: Print Name and Date lines at the top, e.g. true. Default false (Cornell notes: true).

orientation.description: portrait or landscape, e.g. "landscape". Default portrait.

page_size.description: Paper size: Letter, Half Letter (5.5x8.5), Legal, Tabloid (11x17), A5, A4, A3 or B5, e.g. "A4". Default Letter (A4 for millimetre paper). "8.5x11", "US letter" and "A4 landscape" also work.

pages.description: Number of identical pages in the PDF, 1 to 100, e.g. 5 or "ten". Default 1.

paper_type.description: Paper type, e.g. "lined" (default), "college ruled", "wide ruled", "cornell", "music staff", "guitar tab" or "calligraphy".

ruling.description: Lined and Cornell paper: "wide" (11/32 in), "college" (9/32 in) or "narrow" (1/4 in), or a length such as "8 mm". Default college on US pages, 8 mm on A pages.

slant_angle.description: Calligraphy: slant line angle in degrees from horizontal, 30 to 90, e.g. 55 (default, copperplate).

spacing.description: Line spacing with a unit. Lined and Cornell: distance between lines, e.g. "8 mm" or "9/32 inch" (or use ruling). Music staff and guitar tab: gap between staff lines, e.g. "2 mm". Calligraphy: x-height, e.g. "5 mm". Default: college ruled on US pages, 8 mm on A pages, 2 mm staff gap, 5 mm x-height.

staves.description: Music staff or guitar tab: staves per page, 1 to 20, e.g. 12. Default fills the page (12 music, up to 10 tab on Letter).

title.description: Optional heading printed at the top, e.g. "Physics lab 3". Longer titles are shortened to 80 characters. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters print.

name: generate_note_paper
title: Generate note paper
